name: helix-formats
description: File formats read into plain data, and written from it: glTF 2.0 and GLB models, AngelCode BMFont text fonts, the tables of TrueType and OpenType fonts; PNG and QOI images and DEFLATE compression written as raylib 5.5 writes them. Pure Haxe: bytes or text in, data out; no I/O. Depends on helix-math.
